title: “A Christmas Carol”
seo_title: A Christmas Carol in Joplin, MO – Dec 10, 2026
description: A Christmas Carol is a holiday stage production from CMI Entertainment and Entertainment Central Productions Orlando, a faithful adaptation of Charles Dickens' classic that uses projections, Christmas carols, costumes, and puppetry. Ebenezer Scrooge travels with the ghosts of Christmas Past, Present, and Future and learns about kindness, generosity, and redemption, and the show is aimed at audiences of all ages. It is a one-off performance on December 10, 2026 (Time TBD) at Connect2Culture, 212 West 7th Street in Joplin, MO, with tickets at $70 plus fees.
